exit 0
--- stdout
Inspect the provider catalog
Usage:
liza providers [command]
Available Commands:
detect Detect installed catalog providers
list List catalog providers
refresh Refresh the provider catalog cache
Flags:
-h, --help help for providers
Global Flags:
--check-update check for a Liza update before running
-C, --project-root string Liza project root for state commands
--update-channel string update check channel: stable or main (default "stable")
-v, --verbose verbose output
Use "liza providers [command] --help" for more information about a command.
--- stderr
